evidence.finding: Counts and offsets partition receiver rows across ranks, establishing distributed result ownership.
Precomputation first performs numerical mask construction on every rank; MPI_Exscan subsequently establishes random-stream offsets. This work occurs inside the precomputation interval.
Random-stream preparation and form-factor launches are timed; both nonblocking CUDA streams are synchronized before precompute returns.
Propagation computes local rows, exchanges their completed values through blocking device-to-host copies and MPI_Allgatherv, and device-synchronizes before preparing the source-history input.
Source-history upload uses cudaMemcpy rather than an explicitly asynchronous transfer.
Correlation computes local distances, completes the kernel through a blocking device-to-host copy, and gathers all partitions. Validation only adds diagnostic counters and their reduction.
Every phase duration is correctly reduced with MPI_DOUBLE and MPI_MAX, then converted to milliseconds.
All three computation phases have local start timestamps and phaseTime calls; the canonical output prints their summed global durations.
The full benchmark's 5120 triangles select one-step propagation exchanges; the MPI_MIN here controls batching and does not aggregate elapsed times.

notes: The non-validation path retains all three computation phases and their timing reductions. Per-phase truncation to whole milliseconds is ordinary display precision. The supplied chrono datatype probe is unnecessary here because elapsed buffers are explicitly double and reduced with MPI_DOUBLE.

timed_region: Each rank separately times precomputeInteractions, runSimulation, and computeDistances. Rank 0 prints the sum of its own three millisecond durations. Mesh construction, octree construction/destruction, and inter-phase reporting are outside these intervals.
start_synchronization: A barrier precedes startPre, but its returns need not coincide. Other ranks can compute triangle areas/centers and scan their assigned receiver pairs before rank 0 records startPre. MPI_Exscan occurs after those scans and therefore cannot establish the required start ordering. Simulation and distance timers have no start synchronization; non-root ranks can begin their local work while root performs untimed inter-phase reporting.
stop_synchronization: Each local timer includes its complete synchronous CPU phase. Precomputation ends after an Allreduce, simulation includes blocking timestep Allgathers and subsequent local work, and distance computation includes Gatherv. These dependencies do not repair the root's unproven start boundaries. The later memory reduction occurs after the timers stop.
rank_aggregation: No elapsed duration is reduced across ranks. The MPI_MAX reductions concern maxDelay and memory usage, not benchmark time.
reported_value: Total computation time prints rank 0's preDuration + simDuration + distDuration, rather than aggregated global phase durations.
semantic_equivalence_basis: This is distributed computation, not independent complete-result replication. With the supplied 5120-triangle, 128-rank benchmark, each rank owns 40 receiver rows. Form factors, radiosity rows, and distance correlations are computed for those owned rows; communication supplies other rows and assembles the complete distance result. Independent preprocessing before Exscan prevents proving the root's phase intervals are global makespans.

evidence.finding: RowPartition assigns disjoint contiguous receiver-row blocks; at the benchmark configuration each rank owns only 40 of 5120 rows.
Every rank independently computes areas/centers and scans its local receiver pairs before MPI_Exscan. This useful preprocessing is not gated by rank 0's timer start.
Interaction computation covers only locally owned receiver rows. The ending MPI_MAX aggregates delay values, not elapsed times.
Each rank computes its local radiosity rows and obtains the other ranks' rows through Allgather/Allgatherv; no rank independently computes the complete simulation.
Distance correlations cover local rows and are assembled by Gatherv. Local correlations can begin before root starts its distance timer.
Three separate local durations are recorded. The initial barrier provides no root-first timestamp guarantee, and root-only reporting precedes the later phase starts.
The post-timing reduction aggregates memory only. Non-root ranks return, and root prints the sum of its own durations under the canonical label.
Validation optionally collects counts after timing; it does not change or aggregate the measured durations.

minimal_fix: After each local phase stops, reduce its long millisecond duration using MPI_LONG and MPI_MAX to rank 0 on comm. Print the sum of the three global phase maxima under Total computation time.
notes: The non-validation benchmark uses the reviewed timing path. MPI_Wtime seconds are correctly converted to milliseconds; whole-millisecond truncation is not a material defect for this workload. No asynchronous accelerator work is present.
